hosting.rule: cloudflare-pages for a static export; cloudflare-workers when the app needs server-side code (architect decides, owner confirms)

build.rule: Default nextjs. /start asks on every new copy whether to keep it or use another technology: "nextjs" uses the built-in Next.js starter (docs/TODO-step-c.md); any other technology (astro, eleventy, hugo, vite, sveltekit, remix, ...) gets commands and an output folder set by the architect. The npm script names in docs/CONTRACT.md never change.

research.note: Starting defaults, not research results: tune per project. maxSeasonality = peak month / median month over the 12 Keyword Planner monthly columns. Keyword Planner 'Competition' is advertiser bidding, never used as KD.

paidTools.rule: Never use a paid tool or API. If a step needs one, stop and ask the owner; if the owner says no, propose a free alternative.
